title: Hunts FH-014: Bind placement to share and claim

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 1, Physical entry. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Resolve Hunt placement with safe redirect and canonical host, authenticated continuation and scoped proof. Done when: Crawler, wrong-origin URL, revoked placement and cross-run token cannot claim. Requires: FH-003, FH-010, FH-013. Owner role: Web and QR.
